notable_absence.finding: The nested sub-list under 'Self-managed Couchbase Server' (Docker Install, Couchbase Autonomous Operator, Kubernetes, OpenShift, AWS/Azure/GCP Marketplace) links to six distinct pages across the operator/ and server/ doc trees, none of which have been extracted in any round encountered so far. Rather than mint one placeholder stub per sub-page - which would produce six single-use concepts for one bullet list - they are folded into a single server:self-managed-deployment concept, matching this page's own treatment of them as one nested list under one heading.

cross_component_finding: This page's only substantive technical claim (sdk:no-load-balancer-required) is an architectural recommendation that applies regardless of deployment target (Capella or self-managed) - it is about how the SDK's cluster-map-based routing interacts with the network path to the cluster, not a Capella-vs-self-managed distinction. That contrasts with howtos/distributed-acid-transactions-from-the-sdk.json's cross_product_finding from an earlier round, where Capella and self-managed Server prerequisites genuinely diverge (Capella drops the NTP and minimum-server-version checks). Deployment topology recommendations and prerequisite checklists don't diverge along the same Capella/self-managed line by default; each has to be checked on its own facts.
cross_product_finding: The 'Deploying Couchbase Server' list treats Capella and self-managed Server as siblings under one 'Further Reading' heading with no comparative framing at all (no 'choose Capella if...' guidance) - deployment.md defers the actual deployment-model decision entirely to the linked pages, none of which this page's own content engages with.
